thesis: VTRS is a post-earnings spike that has already used up its upside: price sits at the 52-week high and equals the mean analyst target, RSI14 is about 75 and price is roughly 3.5 ATR above SMA20, so a mean-reversion pullback is more likely than continuation. The business underneath is flat (revenue -0.3% y/y, missed consensus), GAAP loss widened, and debt is heavy (13.58B vs 2.01B cash) with a pending Pacira acquisition that raises financing and execution risk. A roughly $100M Q4 supply hit from Nashik is an unpriced overhang. The regime is neutral with tech weak and rising yields (10-year at 5.048), so a leveraged, rate-sensitive name has little macro tailwind. The technical card itself says chasing is poor, so buying now at the high is the wrong entry.
